newsitem.title: UK: Little reaction on European meals to Chicago rally.
newsitem.headline: Little reaction on European meals to Chicago rally.

text.p: There was little reaction among European meals brokers to the rally on the Chicago soy futures market on Wednesday afternoon.
"Chicago was looking oversold, but it is still a buyers market with growing condition in the U.S. and Europe almost perfect," said one broker.
Earlier sellers had offered South American soymeal pellets as much as $12 lower following Tuesday night's sharply lower Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were quoted unchanged to a few dollars lower in sympathy with soymeal.
In light trading high protein soymeal fetched $275.50 and $276 a tonne for Jul while $230 was paid for Nov/Dec and $234 for May/Oct.
